clock.interval: immutable accepted base revision at t; prepare interval [t,t+dt]
clock.temperature_input_stage: trial interval-end thermal state; stage_time_s must equal t+dt
clock.source_emission_stage: accepted interval-start temperature remains canonical during [t,t+dt]
clock.geometry_commit: candidate accepted at t+dt only after parent preflights all ports
clock.rollback: discard prepared proposal; accepted commit rollback not provided
clock.subcycling: mechanics may subcycle inside interval without committing partial geometry

units_and_reference.coordinates: m, reference physical xyz; x width, y gap, z axial
units_and_reference.stress_free_temperature_K: required scalar; source benchmark declares 300 K
units_and_reference.reference_density: 7900 kg/m3 at 293.15 K assigned room reference; rho_ref(T_ref)=7900/(1+s(T_ref))^3
units_and_reference.current_density: rho_ref/det(F); do not multiply by a second thermal-density correction
units_and_reference.area_and_volume: full 3D m2 and m3; height included once; deposited energy is integrated J
units_and_reference.endcap_mask: z faces are explicit and must not silently enter perimeter-only source inventories

ownership.mechanics_material: this component owns bounded expansion/E/rho provenance
ownership.high_temperature_caloric_transport_phase: separate ss304-thermal-properties-20261029 component owns enthalpy/k/sigma/phase laws
ownership.thermal_inventory: heat-feedback component owns electrode enthalpy/T and canonical adsorbate inventory
ownership.species: no species mutation, no second electron/heavy evolution, empty species parent/event IDs
ownership.electron_emission: pic-thermal-field-emission-20261029 owns unified law and heat partition; geometry exports signed material-outward normals/areas with same accepted surface/mesh revision
ownership.geometry: reference/deformed coordinates, areas/normals, mass mapping and mechanical work interface
ownership.global_commit: parent owns all-port atomic acceptance and physical launch

range.interpretation: selected source-data domain, NOT physical melting temperature
range.no_automatic_extension: a new thermal/phase property range does not qualify solid expansion or elasticity above773.15 K

energy.missing: qualified thermoelastic caloric/work exchange including changing E/eigenstrain; cannot silently set deformation work to zero

readiness.fixed_geometry_heat_pilot: may consume unchanged mesh after independent parent qualification; this component does not authorize it

concrete_conflicts: Thermal v1 keeps fixed mesh; available conservative overlap/affine map is benchmark-only and cannot move the native nonuniform field mesh.
No actual mechanical feed/short support law is specified. Nominal free/restraint cases are implemented but not a connected-assembly solution.
Thermal work cannot be debited when deformation is active until its constitutive/work law is supplied.
Existing matched source is outside the selected mechanics-data range after the admitted early prefix; no clipping or unchanged-history restart is allowed.
